dedupe_keys.name: baumkataster stadt leipzig municipal tree register

description: The Leipzig tree register (Baumkataster) holds the locations of trees in public streets and on city-owned land in Leipzig, including parks and green spaces, cemeteries, allotment associations, woodland, riverbanks, sports grounds, schools and childcare facilities. It is maintained by the city's Office for Urban Green and Waters (Amt für Stadtgrün und Gewässer), which is responsible for Leipzig's blue-green infrastructure, and published on the city's open data portal. Coverage is the city of Leipzig, one point per tree; it was first issued on 15 February 2022 and last updated on 15 July 2024 according to the portal, with continuous updating. Format and access: CSV, GeoJSON and GeoPackage exports and a WFS service, free without registration. Licence: Datenlizenz Deutschland Namensnennung 2.0 (dl-de/by-2-0). Caveats: the city states that data capture of tree sites is not yet complete, private trees are not included, and the attribute list is not described on the portal page. It gives a street and park tree inventory for urban heat, stormwater, canopy and windthrow exposure studies and green infrastructure planning. Related catalogue records are the Zurich and Copenhagen tree registers, comparable city inventories.
